key: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune
0.comment: Urakusai: Urakusai and the Chronicles of the Six Kitsune
0.content: Urakusai's original Chronicles of the Six Kitsune, popular five hundred years ago, tells of six apprentices of the Great Kitsune Hakushin, including the eldest, Itaru the Black Fox. The new edition on sale at the Yae Publishing House is a lightly revised adaptation by an author who knew of Urakusai only by reputation; volume 6 comments on Urakusai's banishment.

1.content: A sword Urakusai made and carried, named for his drunken cut of the bake-danuki's stage curtains. Legend has it he gave it to Arataki of the Front Gate; the Otogi King's own battles use another weapon, and an oni tale says it ended up with a tailor girl. The sword may never have cut an enemy.

key: A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits
2.comment: Urakusai: A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits
2.content: A hit light novel written by Urakusai's memory through the failed novelist Tomoyuki. Its incantation lets youkai memories borrow a human body for a day or two; users were possessed and began to act oddly, as with Katou Shingo. Urakusai included it so other youkai could enjoy life and leave without regret, being fond of humanity.

3.content: The "night parade of a hundred demons": youkai gatherings organised by the Kitsune Saiguu, where drinking, storytelling and competitive displays of power covered the sky, once so numerous their silhouettes hid the moon. Urakusai asked Yae Miko for one last Hyakkiyakou, which she arranged in Banquet of Parting.
